text:
```yaml
name: Rebuild Model Site

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  rebuild-site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Build and deploy site
        run: |
          policyengine-us build-site
        env:
          POLICYENGINE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.POLICYENGINE_API_KEY }}
```
